title: A lane does not close until its records pull request has merged
why: Owner, Nov 1 17:44 CST, forwarding a home repo session's finding: the gap is in every repo, not only home.
note: Shape: a lane's archive or close is refused while its record step (the records PR) is unmerged. Incident: home's wheel lane closed before its records PR landed. Ready: no open question. Port: yes, every repo.
